messages:
ella_sales: Pinging the team — Connex wants a SSO + SCIM POC with RBAC mapping. They asked for Wed 10am PT. Also asking about Dedicated pricing and domain controls. Looping SE + security.

raj_se: I can run the POC. Quick clarifying Qs: will they use JIT provisioning via SAML? How many groups/users to sync (rough numbers)? Do they need group->role mapping (1:many)? Any requirement for SCIM delta latency?

ella_sales: Copying Connex IT message I got: "We use Okta, need SCIM group sync for teams, require cert rollover process and SAML ACS URL whitelisting. Also need audit logs and SCIM delta within ~2 minutes."

maria_sec: Security checklist notes: TLS + at-rest encryption covered. For Private we support KMS/HSM; for Hosted we can discuss BYOK if they require it. I'll ask for their SOC2 or similar. Also need their vendor questionnaire answered before Dedicated.

izzy_prod: Product notes: RBAC is supported via group->role mapping (SCIM groups -> internal roles). Domain lock: we verify tenant via email ownership or DNS TXT claim. SCIM supports incremental delta and full sync; paging supported for >1k groups. Default SCIM rate-limit is 5 req/s for Hosted but can be increased on Dedicated.

raj_se: POC plan (high level):
1) Exchange SAML metadata + ACS URL
2) Provide SCIM base URL + token with scim scopes
3) Upload a role mapping file to map Okta groups -> Redwood roles
4) Run a limited sync (start with 100 users) then ramp

Minimal config example I'll hand them:
```json
{
  "scim_base": "https://scim.connex.example",
  "token_scope": ["scim:read","scim:write"],
  "role_map": {"Connex Admins": "redwood-admin", "Ops Team": "redwood-ops"}
}
```

jamie_legal: Legal notes: we need to confirm data residency (they asked about EU). Sales — get their legal contact. I'll prepare DPA + standard amendment and send SOC2. Also check if they require data deletion SLA.

ella_sales: Pricing Q from Connex: "If we go Dedicated for compliance, what's the delta vs Hosted for ~100M tokens/month?" Can we give a rough number?

izzy_prod: Ballpark: Hosted list unit ~$0.0008/token -> ~ $80k for 100M (monthly). Dedicated is a commit + infra premium; rough delta could be +$20-40k/mo depending on GPU footprint and replication needs. I'll get finance a proper quote but can say Dedicated typically requires a monthly commit. For POC we can grant a short reserved slot (2 weeks) for evaluation.

maria_sec: Flag — SCIM paging for >1000 groups matters. If they expect >1k groups we need to enable cursor paging and document throttling best practices. Also confirm their Okta token rotation policy; we may need to support automated rekeying.

raj_se: Action items: I'll draft the POC runbook and send to Connex by EOD. Need security sign-off on BYOK handling for Hosted (maria_sec), and legal to send DPA + SOC2 (jamie_legal). I'll also include a minimal SCIM test harness.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Canary deploy scheduled Wed 09:30 PT — no customer impact expected.

ella_sales: Connex prefers Wed 10am PT. Raj — can you confirm the runbook and own the invite? Maria / Jamie — can you send docs before Wed?

maria_sec: I'll DM the vendor questionnaire + list of required docs. ✅

jamie_legal: I'll send the DPA + SOC2 and loop in legal contact.

raj_se: Locked: Wed 10am PT. I'll post the runbook in #eng-sre and include the SCIM test harness + rollback steps (fallback to hosted-compatible model variant if Dedicated not ready).

ella_sales: Thanks all — I'll update Connex and get their Okta admin + legal on the calendar. :tada:
